# Joining County Data with 

```{r}
csv_files <- list.files("Raw Socioeconomic Files", pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

library(sf)

# Read the shapefile (adjust path if needed)
counties_sf <- st_read("US Counties Boundaries/c_05mr24/c_05mr24.shp")

# Ensure FIPS in shapefile is character
counties_sf$FIPS <- as.character(counties_sf$FIPS)

for (file in csv_files) {
  name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file))
  df <- read.csv(file)
  assign(name, df)
  
  # Standardize FIPS in CSV to always be 5 characters
  df$FIPS <- sprintf("%05d", as.numeric(df$FIPS))

  # Join the data
  counties_sf <- merge(counties_sf, df, by = "FIPS", all.x = TRUE)
}

# st_write(counties_sf, "counties_with_data.geojson", driver = "GeoJSON")
st_write(counties_sf, "US_Counties_SocioEconomics.gpkg", layer = "US_Counties_Data", delete_layer = TRUE)
```
